plugins.description: Recipe-driven HyperFrames motion graphics. One skill, hf-motion, scaffolds a parameterized project from a named recipe (intro-kinetic: a 15 s kinetic-typography self-introduction), fills it from key=value parameters, lints, checks, snapshots and renders it through the official hyperframes plugin. Same skeleton, swap the content.
